summary.text: Michael Hoyt is a Democratic state representative from Windsor-4 District who was appointed on December 2, 2025, and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, he is an attorney who has served on the Hartford Selectboard.

paragraphs.text: Michael Hoyt earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont and a law degree from Vanderbilt University Law School, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working at Dartmouth College, serving on the Hartford Selectboard, and serving as an attorney for the Vermont Legislature and the Vermont Department of Labor.
Hoyt was appointed to the Vermont House of Representatives on December 2, 2025, succeeding Heather Surprenant.
He is running in the 2026 general election against Justin Schoville and Kyle Hansen.
